reasoning: 驗證目標：叫用 Satellite Channel Preset Browse 時，顯示所有目前設為 Preset 的衛星頻道的可瀏覽清單。為什麼這樣切：條款的判準是清單成員資格——設為 preset 的在內、未設的不在內；僅列出「有東西」的實作應失敗，故前置條件同時要求存在未設為 preset 的可收頻道，ER 以雙向斷言表述。與 107 的差別：該 leaf 驗的是 preset 的排列順序與刪除能力，本 leaf 驗成員資格（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Preset Browse lists exactly the channels set to presets
tcs.test_item: When the Satellite Channel Preset Browse function is invoked, the HU shall display a browsable list of all available Satellite Audio Channels currently set to Presets
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three receivable Satellite Audio channels are set as presets
5. At least one further receivable Satellite Audio channel is not set as a preset
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Invoke the Satellite Channel Preset Browse function
2. Read the displayed list
3. Scroll the displayed list
tcs.expected_result:
1. A list is displayed
2. The list holds the three channels set as presets and does not hold the channel that is not set as a preset
3. The list scrolls
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
